text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at the training track...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What should I do for training today?
Hm,
considering the skies are cloudy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What good timing. You there! I'd like
your input
on something!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What will you be focusing on today?
Researching
a new running style, or
quick decision-making?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, an excellent choice! The running
techniques
of Umamusume are always
improving.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I see. The success or failure of a race
hinges on
split-second decisions, which
makes the speed of
one's thinking
important indeed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I shall take that into consideration. I
wonder what
results will come of this
chance meeting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Happenstance and serendipity are
factors that
cannot be ignored in
research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That is why I took advantage of two
chance
occurrences—you and the cloudy
skies.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You too should embrace happenstance
to avoid
falling into a rut! Doing so is the
path to truth!
